[[Johto]] (by {{adv|Ruby}})| gender=Gender unknown| ability={{a|Natural Cure}}| epnum=PS175| epname=The Last Battle IX| catchepnum=PS181| catchepnametiming=Prior to | catchepname=Creeping Past Cacnea| prevonum=251| noevo=incap| released=yes| releaseep=PS267| releasename=It All Ends Now VIII{{tt|*|Released by Pryce in PS180}}| media=special| va=no| }} '''Celebi''' (Japanese: '''セレビィ''' ''Celebi'') is a [[Mythical Pokémon]] that has involved itself among several important events in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}=== [[File:GS Ball Adventures.png|thumb|175px|left|The GS Ball used to capture Celebi]] Celebi was the object of the [[Masked Man]]'s longing, and, the only {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} he could never manage to capture on his own. His dedication to acquire it for his plans was so strong that he would visit the shrine in the [[Ilex Forest]] to attempt to catch it, not being aware of the existence of the [[GS Ball]]'s purpose. Celebi first appeared in ''[[PS175|The Last Battle IX]]'', watching the Ilex Forest from its shrine. In ''[[PS180|The Last Battle XIV]]'', the Masked Man completes the GS Ball using the [[Rainbow Wing|Rainbow]] and [[Silver Wing]]s and succeeds in opening the shrine and capturing Celebi. [[Pryce]] then used Celebi to [[Time travel|take him back]] to a time where he lost something precious, his two {{p|Lapras}}. {{adv|Gold}} dives in after them in an attempt to save Celebi, and eventually manages to after help from the other [[Pokédex holder]]s. The GS Ball was destroyed by [[Pibu]], and Pryce ended up stuck in the voids of time, where Celebi sends past memories of the [[Boy and his Lapras|song]] his old chums had written for him when his two Lapras died. ==={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}=== After the events with the Masked Man and before ''[[PS181|Creeping Past Cacnea]]'', Celebi purposely joined {{adv|Ruby}}'s team before he moved to [[Hoenn]], although he didn't even know what Pokémon it was. Celebi was kept in its {{i|Poké Ball}} for most of his journey, with Ruby only calling upon it as a last resort due to its powers being a mystery to him. In ''[[PS183|Trying to Trounce Torchic]]'', Ruby uses Celebi to defeat a wild {{p|Seviper}} after the rest of his and {{adv|Sapphire}}'s Pokémon are defeated, although its identity wasn't revealed in this chapter. [[File:Celebi destroying Red and Blue Orbs.png|thumb|200px|Celebi destroying the Red and Blue Orbs]] In ''[[PS255|With a Spoink in Your Step I]]'', Ruby and Sapphire travelled through the flow of time to reach {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}. Since Ruby had the Time Travel Pokémon with him the flow of time was somewhat unstable. [[PS259|Upon leaving]], Ruby and Sapphire experienced the same problems. In ''[[PS267|It All Ends Now VIII]]'', Celebi was used in the battle with [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]] by having it take the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s from them and breaking them into pieces. Using its time travel powers, Celebi brought the people who had lost their lives in the battle back to life. With its duty fulfilled, Celebi sent Ruby away to be with his friends and left. ==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}=== Prior to ''[[PS458|All About Arceus VII]]'', Celebi sensed the destruction that {{adv|Arceus}} would bring upon the [[Johto]] and [[Sinnoh]] regions. It subsequently released Pryce from the Crack of Time that he entered in years ago so he could help in the battle. Celebi was [[PS459|later]] seen collecting herbs to cure {{adv|Giovanni}}'s illness, and was assisted by a [[Pibu|pair]] of [[Spiky-eared Pichu|Pichu]] and the [[Team Rocket Elite Trio]]. It was soon attacked by several {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s, but Ken, Al, and Harry managed to get the stolen herbs back from them, and urged Celebi to get to the [[Ruins of Alph]] immediately. [[PS460|Soon enough]], they reached Giovanni, and Celebi gave its medicine to him, curing him from his long-time illness. ==Personality and characteristics== Celebi is a caring individual, even helping those that have done it harm. It has a strong sense of duty, and often goes across the world in order to help fix times of crisis. Celebi is able to [[Time travel|travel through time]], with one way going through the [[Ilex Forest]]'s shrine. It is able to fly using the pair of wings on its back. Celebi is also able to alter the timeline, having undone certain people's deaths during the crisis in [[Hoenn]]. ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Celebi}} {{Pryce's Pokémon|Psychic|Grass}} {{Ruby's Pokémon|Psychic|Grass}} {{Project Manga notice}} [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Ruby's Pokémon]] [[Category:Pryce's Pokémon]] [[Category:Released Pokémon]] [[Category:Team Rocket's Pokémon]] [[Category:Gender unknown characters (Pokémon)|Celebi]] [[es:Celebi (Pocket Monsters Special)]] [[it:Celebi (La Grande Avventura)]]
